SL-004 is green: all 27 tests pass, including the new validation tests, and `tsc --noEmit` is clean. I committed it as `bb46731` (`green(SL-004): …`), which touches only production code (+27/−3 lines, under the 200-line budget). - **Backend:** - `src/tasks.ts` has a new `titleProblem()`. It trims the title, then returns "A title is required." if it is empty or "The title is too long (maximum 500 characters)." if it is over 500. - `src/app.ts` uses it in `POST /api/tasks` to return `400 {error:{code:"validation_failed",message}}` before anything is created. - **Frontend:** `public/index.html` has a new `

`. `public/app.js` writes the server's `error.message` into it with `textContent` when the response is not OK. It clears the message and the input on success, and keeps the typed title on rejection. - **Database:** untouched, as the slice asks. **What I did not verify:** - **Page behavior:** I did not run the page in a browser. The tests only check the static HTML and script text, so the real submit-and-show-message flow is unchecked. - **Architecture checks:** I ran no separate check; I assume they are part of the `npm test` run, which passed. - **Mutation testing:** I did not run Stryker. **Behavior I left out because no test asks for it** (each would need a new red phase): - A `title` that is missing or not a string still fails on `.trim()` and gives a 500 instead of a `validation_failed`. - A body that is not valid JSON gives no `invalid_json` 400, although the architecture describes one. - If the server is unreachable or returns a non-JSON error, the page script will throw instead of showing a message. The slice is ready for the audit (`/speckit-sddpp-cycle-audit`). I did not run `ppc refactor`.
